content.text: Simplest: a global top-level `exclude`. The local always_run hooks ignore filenames, so they're unaffected.

edits.newText:
minimum_prek_version: "0.2.0"

# Agent tooling directories are exempt from all hooks.
exclude: ^\.(claude|agents|cursor|codex|pi|entire)/

content.text:
I added a top-level `exclude: ^\.(claude|agents|cursor|codex|pi|entire)/` to `.pre-commit-config.yaml`. Files under those six directories are now skipped by every hook, including `trailing-whitespace`. `prek validate-config` accepts the file. I didn't run a commit to confirm the skill file now passes.

The two local `bundle-*` hooks use `always_run` and `pass_filenames: false`. The exclude doesn't apply to them because they don't receive a file list. They still run on every commit, but `mise run bundle:finalize` and `mise run bundle:lint` only see whatever those tasks scan.
commit the pre commit and then i will commit mine
